entry.title: Sol Next v6.3.0 Public Edition (Zero-API-Key BYOK) — Android AI Phone Agent Built Upon Mika
entry.summary: Open-source, zero-built-in-key (BYOK) Android 10–16 AI phone agent paying tribute to wangzan101/Mika (Apache-2.0). Features Rust v3.10 UI pruning (17–45 microseconds, -74% to -97% tokens), 1:1 Display 0 VirtualDisplay cloning (0.0px drift), HTTP/3 QUIC 0-RTT with smart circuit breaker, 64-round Xiaomi HyperOS anti-pause resilience, carrier-grade AI phone calls with 3x4 DTMF, non-interactive CLI (--json), and stdio MCP Server.
